description.name: Arrows of Rapture
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)] if the user has Maleficium = 1, grants [Quick Cast 2] to the user, causes Maleficium -1 to the user

description.name: Attach Dark 3 with Stacking

description.name: Time Compression Mode
description.text: Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, instant cast speed for Dark abilities, casts Relentless Blades after using two Dark abilities, removed after triggering, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
